snapshot.title: Trump says there will either be a deal with Iran or US will ‘finish the job’
snapshot.description: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump said on Monday the United States would either reach ​a deal with Iran or “finish the job,” renewing his threat of military action as Tehran projects defiance following the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
